articles.title: Sam Bankman-Fried loses appeal to overturn 25-year prison sentence
articles.snippet: A federal appeals court upheld the former FTX chief’s conviction, while his bid for clemency from President Donald Trump appears to face steep political odds.

articles.title: Crypto Biz: SpaceX fuels tokenization’s next boom
articles.snippet: Tokenized RWAs surge despite crypto volatility, Kraken launches SpaceX IPO xStocks, prediction markets outpace onchain gambling and Sam Bankman-Fried seeks a Trump pardon.

articles.title: Big Tech crash, oil volatility rattles markets: Will Bitcoin hold above $60K?
articles.snippet: With $1.9 billion exiting the spot Bitcoin ETFs and tech stocks under pressure, BTC is failing as a hedge and at risk of falling below the $60,000 support.

articles.title: Hungary to reverse crypto trading crackdown after EU scrutiny
articles.snippet: Hungary’s government said it will unwind crypto trading restrictions that required approved validation for conversions and exposed users and service providers to criminal liability.

articles.title: AI models led to a ‘vulnerability apocalypse’ in crypto security: Immunefi CEO
articles.snippet: The proliferation of new frontier AI models is the main catalyst behind the latest resurgence in DeFi hacks, according to Immunefi CEO Mitchell Amador.
